purpose: Teach: 西海岸/ルパン/カンヌ/トロント/スリランカ/レバノン/マニラ/江戸川

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、アメリカ西海岸で留学経験がおありだって、メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi, apparently one of your customers studied abroad on the US West Coast.
lines.style: Soft, wondering tone. Sharing a discovered detail like turning over a small stone. Gentle pace. Quiet delight that Aoi has interesting people in her orbit.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、ルパン三世の映画が大好きだって、メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi, one of your customers loves Lupin III movies, apparently.
lines.style: Continuing the gentle thread of discovery. Slight uptick on the reveal. Warm, intimate — like sharing secrets about someone they both care about. Unhurried.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、カンヌ映画祭に行かれたって、メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi, your customer has actually been to the Cannes Film Festival.
lines.style: A note of quiet admiration coloring the words. Slight lean forward with the fact. Wonder at the world this customer inhabits. Soft, not breathless.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、トロントに親族がいらっしゃるって、メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi, your customer has relatives in Toronto, it seems.
lines.style: Building the portrait piece by piece. Thoughtful pause before the reveal. Voice stays warm but the words feel like they're fitting into a larger picture. Reflective.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、スリランカ紅茶のソムリエ資格をお持ちだって、メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi, apparently your customer holds a sommelier certification in Sri Lankan tea.
lines.style: A beat of delight at the specificity. Each detail landing with tender fascination. Slower on the unusual credentials. The appreciation of someone's hidden depth.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、レバノン料理のレストランを開きたいって、メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi, your customer is actually hoping to open a Lebanese restaurant someday.
lines.style: Warmth shifts to something more meaningful — a dream being named. Steady, gentle voice. The tone of someone who recognizes ambition and honors it without fanfare.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、マニラに駐在経験がおありだって、メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi, your customer was once stationed in Manila.
lines.style: Another layer added. Quieter now, almost reflective. The voice settling into the weight of all these places, all these parts of someone's life. Steady exhale.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、江戸川区の花火大会に行かれるって、メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi, apparently your customer is going to the Edogawa fireworks festival this year.
lines.style: Gentle landing on something small and close. The voice softens into something almost intimate — the detail that brings the world back home. Quiet, warm fade.
